crossRefs.note: Behold, he goes by me, and I don’t see him. He passes on also, but I don’t perceive him.
Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!
“If I go east, he is not there; if west, I can’t find him;
If it is a matter of strength, behold, he is mighty! If of justice, ‘Who,’ says he, ‘will summon me?’
“Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.
I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
Therefore Yahweh will wait, that he may be gracious to you; and therefore he will be exalted, that he may have mercy on…
No weapon that is formed against you will prevail; and you will condemn every tongue that rises against you in…
But as for me, I will look to Yahweh. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe…
Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this:
he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.
My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.
Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us.
Who among you fears Yahweh and obeys the voice of his servant? He who walks in darkness and has no light, let him trust…
Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.
Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of…

translations.web: How much less when you say you don’t see him. The cause is before him, and you wait for him!
translations.bsb: How much less, then, when you say that you do not see Him, that your case is before Him and you must wait for Him,
translations.kjv: Although thou sayest thou shalt not see him, yet judgment is before him; therefore trust
translations.asv: How much less when thou sayest thou beholdest him not, The cause is before him, and thou waitest for him!
